import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainMayerVietoris
import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomology
import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.HomologicalComplexAbelian
import Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.HomologySequence

/-!+# The cochain Mayer--Vietoris sequence

The cochain restriction and overlap-difference maps form a short exact sequence
of cochain complexes. Its homology sequence gives the connecting map and the
three exactness statements for two simplicial subcomplexes.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The degreewise product of two integral simplicial cochain complexes. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex (K L : SSet) :
    CochainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ :=
  CochainComplex.of
    (fun n => ModuleCat.of ℤ (IntegralSimplicialCochain K n × IntegralSimplicialCochain L n))
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom
      ((simplicialCochainDifferential K n).prodMap (simplicialCochainDifferential L n)))
    (by
      intro n
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact Prod.ext (simplicialCochainDifferential_squared φ.1)
        (simplicialCochainDifferential_squared φ.2))

variable {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex)

/-- Simultaneous restriction as a morphism of cochain complexes. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction :
    integralSimplicialCochainComplex (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) ⟶
      integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex A B :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n))
    (by
      intro n
      simp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex, integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex,
        CochainComplex.of_d]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact Prod.ext
        (simplicialCochainPullback_differential (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) φ).symm
        (simplicialCochainPullback_differential (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) φ).symm)

/-- The overlap difference as a morphism of cochain complexes. -/
def integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference :
    integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex A B ⟶
      integralSimplicialCochainComplex (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) :=
  CochainComplex.ofHom
    (fun n => ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n))
    (by
      intro n
      simp only [integralSimplicialCochainComplex, integralSimplicialCochainPairComplex,
        CochainComplex.of_d]
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      change simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n
          (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) n φ.1 -
            simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n φ.2) =
        simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainDifferential A n φ.1) -
        simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainDifferential B n φ.2)
      rw [map_sub, simplicialCochainPullback_differential,
        simplicialCochainPullback_differential])

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B n) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_f (n : ℕ) :
    (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B).f n =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n) := rfl

/-- The cochain Mayer--Vietoris short complex for two simplicial subcomplexes. -/
def simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex :
    ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat ℤ) ℕ) :=
  ShortComplex.mk (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B)
    (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) (by
      apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
      funext n
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro φ
      exact simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_restriction A B φ)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction_intersectionDifference :
    integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B ≫
        integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B = 0 := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext
  funext n
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro φ
  exact simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_restriction A B φ

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem integralSimplicialCohomologyUnionRestriction_intersectionDifference (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n ≫
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n = 0 := by
  rw [← homologyMap_comp]
  simp

/-- Cochain Mayer--Vietoris is short exact, by the actual degreewise gluing theorem. -/
theorem simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact :
    (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).ShortExact := by
  apply HomologicalComplex.shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact
  intro n
  exact simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree_shortExact A B n

/-- The connecting morphism from overlap cohomology to union cohomology. -/
def simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSimplicialCohomology (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n ⟶
      IntegralSimplicialCohomology (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1) :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).δ n (n + 1) (by simp)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_restriction (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) (n + 1) = 0 :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).δ_comp n (n + 1) (by simp)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisDifference_connecting (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n ≫
      simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B n = 0 :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).comp_δ n (n + 1) (by simp)

/-- Exactness at positive-degree cohomology of the union. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_union (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _
      (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_restriction A B n)).Exact :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).homology_exact₁ n (n + 1) (by simp)

/-- Exactness at the cohomology of the pair of subcomplexes. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_pair (n : ℕ) :
    ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
      (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).Exact :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).homology_exact₂ n

/-- Exactness at the cohomology of the overlap. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_intersection (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _
      (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisDifference_connecting A B n)).Exact :=
  (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex_shortExact A B).homology_exact₃ n (n + 1) (by simp)

end Mumford.Analytic
